meta.title: Uganda Space Community
meta.description: The national platform for Uganda's space ecosystem. Connect, discover, and contribute to Uganda's growing space sector.

hero.heading: Charting Uganda's path {accent:beyond Earth}.
hero.subtitle: Connecting students, researchers, professionals, and organizations across Uganda's growing space ecosystem.

mission.text: The Uganda Space Community Platform brings together everyone working in or interested in Uganda's space sector — from students at Makerere to researchers at the Uganda Space Agency. Discover events, share knowledge, find opportunities, and connect with the people shaping the country's space future.

slideshow.description: Uganda's flagship national campaign for World Space Week 2026, connecting Rocket Revolution to astronomy, Earth observation, aerospace engineering, and local innovation.

teamMembers.name: Ronnie Atuhaire
teamMembers.role: National Coordinator, World Space Week Uganda 2026
teamMembers.bio: Ronnie leads Space Junkies Uganda and coordinates World Space Week Uganda 2026, connecting young Ugandans, institutions, and partners to the global space community.

teamMembers.name: Zoora Harrison
teamMembers.bio: Founder and CEO of StellarView Technologies, Uganda's first space education media brand, making space science accessible to African children through outreach, storytelling, and programme delivery.

teamMembers.name: Nabbaale Grace Lydia
teamMembers.role: Chapter Lead, StellarView Technologies - Makerere University
teamMembers.bio: Electrical Engineering student at Makerere University CEDAT and StellarView Technologies chapter lead, with a strong interest in space science and its potential for Africa's development.

teamMembers.name: Halimah Bukirwa
teamMembers.bio: Founder of Aerobuddies, bringing a people-centred passion for aviation, technology, and problem-solving, building practical pathways for meaningful impact in Uganda's aviation ecosystem.

teamMembers.name: Angu'zu Raymond
teamMembers.organisation: KTA Advocates Centre for Law, Policy and Innovation Initiative
teamMembers.bio: Lawyer, Uganda National Point of Contact to the Space Generation Advisory Council, and Policy and Programs Assistant at KTA Advocates Centre for Law, Policy and Innovation Initiative.

teamMembers.name: Capt Simon Bruno W. Ssenyange
teamMembers.bio: Simon leads Holistic Inclusive Aviation Africa, advancing inclusive aviation and STEAM pathways for young aviation and space professionals across Africa.

teamMembers.name: Navneet Singh
teamMembers.bio: Navneet contributes aerospace technology leadership and technical perspective through Nile Orbitals and the wider Space Uganda ecosystem.

teamMembers.name: O. Samuel Oumo
teamMembers.bio: Samuel is an information systems professional and futurist thinking, writing, and building toward systems that help society imagine a greater world beyond the present.

teamMembers.name: Dr Malcom Chris B
teamMembers.bio: Dr Malcom Chris B supports the astronomy organising team, helping connect public audiences to observation, astronomy learning, and Uganda's growing space community.

teamMembers.name: Bwengye Cosmas
teamMembers.bio: Cosmas contributes to the Uganda Astronomical Society organising team, supporting astronomy outreach and community participation for national space activities.

teamMembers.name: Twesigye Duncan
teamMembers.bio: Duncan contributes STEAM education, coaching, and practical learning support for young people engaging with aerospace, rocketry, and space science.

teamMembers.name: Ayebazibwe Brinton
teamMembers.bio: Brinton supports operations and coordination for StellarView Technologies Ltd, helping turn space outreach ideas into organised public programmes.
